workflow.emptyBefore: No saved recipes. To create one, use
workflow.help:
A saved orchestration recipe that is layered onto the coordinator prompt. It describes the order in which workers start and how their results are combined.

Each recipe is a skill file (kind: coordinator-workflow). Open its contents with the book button in its row. With Free-form selected, the coordinator decides how to proceed.
workflow.label: Workflow

patterns.adversarial: Adversarial validation — one worker produces and another tries to disprove it
patterns.classify: Classify and route — label the input first, then send it to the relevant profile
patterns.fanout: Fan-out and synthesis — workers run in parallel and the coordinator combines the results
patterns.generateFilter: Generate and filter — produce many candidates, then eliminate them
patterns.loop: Loop until complete — repeat rounds until the stop condition is met
patterns.tournament: Tournament — eliminate candidates through pairwise comparisons

systemRoles.title: Agent assignments
systemRoles.hint: Choose which agent runs each system role in this workspace. Empty = the role's built-in agent.
systemRoles.utilitySemantics: The role keeps its own prompt; the chosen agent only supplies its provider and model.
systemRoles.workerSemantics: The chosen agent runs as itself — its own prompt, tools and model — whenever this profile is requested.
